placements.title: owned perspective as the retained asset against commoditized substrate
placements.frame: Does the expression treat owned intelligence or perspective as a possession one keeps, in contrast to a substrate or capability that is merely rented or commoditized?
placements.why: src-2 draws the owned/rented contrast as a general, repeatable distinction ('Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence'), and src-3 extends it into a durable classification ('The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep'). Both are true beyond the words describing them — a recurring thematic stance on ownership versus rental of intelligence/perspective, not a one-time fact or measurement — so they pass the narrative grain test. The existing graph structure and strata are both empty for this repo, and the witness-depth focus section explicitly reports no prior coverage of owned/rented intelligence, substrate-as-commodity, or perspective-as-asset, so no reuse target exists at either the leaf or hub/strata level. Nothing close-but-not-exact exists either, so this mints standalone (NEW) with no under and no lineage.
consulted: Focus witness-depth section — explicit no-match statement
POSITION VERDICTS — OwnershipVsRentedIntelligence position (src-2, src-3) confirms these two expressions share one thematic axis
